effects.name: Bonded
effects.description:
While within 60 feet of the caster, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and you have Resistance to all damage. Each time you take damage, the caster takes the same amount of damage.

The spell ends if the caster drops to 0 Hit Points or if you and the caster become separated by more than 60 feet. It also ends if the spell is cast again on either of the connected creatures.

macro.name: Warding Bond
macro.author: Zl1BOUaPLwDEujaL

description.value:
You touch another creature that is willing and create a mystic connection between you and the target until the spell ends. While the target is within 60 feet of you, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and it has Resistance to all damage. Also, each time it takes damage, you take the same amount of damage.

The spell ends if you drop to 0 Hit Points or if you and the target become separated by more than 60 feet. It also ends if the spell is cast again on either of the connected creatures.

midi-qol: Utility activity applies Bonded effect granting +1 AC, +1 saves, and resistance to all damage types. Uses flags.dae.onUpdateTarget to monitor the target's HP — when the target takes damage, the macro automatically applies the same amount of untyped damage to the caster via applyTokenDamage. Uses flags.dae.onUpdateSource to monitor the caster's HP — if the caster drops to 0 HP, the Bonded effect is automatically removed. The on macro sets up mutual dependentOn between caster and target effects so deleting either cascades. Distance >60ft is checked on each HP update and ends the spell if exceeded.
